basis: explicit class allow/deny lists reviewed against provider construction, external-process/rendering use, frozen-campaign dependencies, and current canonical route coverage; filename-only matching is not used by the runner
unlistedClassPolicy: Every class absent from the quarantine lists is classified as CANONICAL_REQUIRED for this conservative pass; FREEZE_INTEGRITY is a protected invariant and is not implicitly retired by tiering.

CORE_DETERMINISTIC.intent: currently reachable production behavior and bounded deterministic contracts

HISTORICAL_FORENSIC.intent: frozen replay, old request versions, and diagnosis artifacts

LONG_RUNNING.intent: large corpus, rendering, or deliberately slow deterministic checks

PROVIDER_BENCHMARK.intent: provider/network-capable experiments; explicit environment gates remain mandatory

PROVIDER_BENCHMARK.reason: constructs or can reach an external provider, real harness, or network transport

LONG_RUNNING.reason: rendering, live lifecycle, large corpus, or deliberately slow execution

HISTORICAL_FORENSIC.reason: historical audit/replay contracts; not current production route ownership

EXPERIMENT_ONLY.reason: campaign/preflight/scoring/probe artifacts; explicit opt-in even when provider-free

DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE.reason: manual diagnostics and causal probes; not default regression coverage

deletionPolicy: No file is deleted by this manifest. A test is retired only after symbol reachability, freeze/public compatibility dependency, and unique invariant coverage are separately proven.
